_comment: AGR's intervention pool (spec v5). Cards are data; lib/state.js agrResolve() applies them. Three are drawn per round from the enabled set, minus last round's draw when enough remain. Disable one with the scenario key agr_disabled_cards.

cards.title: EMERGENCY STOCKPILE
cards.summary: AGR gains +5 Power, +5 Water, +2 Med, +1 Parts.

cards.title: WORKFORCE RECOVERY
cards._conflict: This game's workers are counts with no non-injury unavailable state. The card refuses until one exists; it is off by default (agr_disabled_cards).

cards.title: MEDICAL REINFORCEMENT
cards.summary: MED gains +1 healing capacity this round. MED still performs the heal.

cards.title: LOGISTICS BOOST
cards.summary: TRN gains +1 transfer approval this round. TRN still approves.

cards.title: CRISIS RESPONSE
cards.summary: The active sector with the lowest Health gains +20 Health.

cards.title: STABILISE SECTOR
cards.summary: Choose 1 active sector and restore +15 Health.

cards.title: RELIEF CREW
cards.summary: Choose 1 sector to receive +1 temporary worker until the round ends.

cards.title: RESERVE CACHE
cards.summary: Choose one resource type and gain an emergency cache.
